run_habitat_benchmark: run a habitat simulator benchmark measuring FPS across multiple processes and GPUs
run_benchmark_with_rendering: run the habitat benchmark with rendering enabled to generate a video output
run_benchmark_with_loaded_actions: run the habitat benchmark using a pre-saved action trajectory file
run_multiprocess_benchmark: run the habitat benchmark across multiple processes distributed across GPUs
run_benchmark_multiple_trials: run the habitat benchmark for multiple trials and report average FPS
